name: build-goals
description: A focused toolkit for clarifying goals and delivering verifiable software projects, Agent Skills, plugins, product PRDs, GitHub READMEs, and project agent instructions.

interface.shortDescription: Deliver software, Skills, plugins, PRDs, READMEs, and agent guides
interface.longDescription: A focused toolkit that turns clarified goals and repository facts into designed, implemented, tested, validated, and deliverable software projects, Agent Skills, Claude Code or Codex plugins, product requirements documents, GitHub READMEs, and project agent instructions.
defaultPrompt: Use shape-idea to turn a rough idea into a clear scope with fully resolved decisions.
Use build-skill or build-plugin to create a verifiable Agent capability.
Use build-prd to produce a research-backed, fully decided product requirements document.
Use vibe-coding to implement a confirmed PRD or modernize an existing project through architecture approval, task approval, TDD, multi-agent delivery, and end-to-end validation.
Use build-readme to explore a repository and create or update its GitHub README after a confirmed preview.
Use build-agents-md to initialize or fully restructure AGENTS.md and its CLAUDE.md single-source link after a confirmed full preview, or handoff to prepare the next session.
